name: tally-bars
title: Tally Bars
description: How everyone answered, as one bar per option with its whole percent: the results of a poll, or the spread of answers after a quiz question. The viewer's own choice is named in words, and a quiz can mark the right option, so nothing depends on colour alone.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/tally-bars

Installed to `components/ui/games/tally-bars.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/tally-bars';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/tally-bars

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
